enriched_activities.activity: Lying in bed scrolling Instagram and replying to Messenger messages, unable to fall asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back on the bed with the light off. Pick up the phone from the pillow. Press the power button to light the screen. Swipe up to unlock. Tap the Instagram icon. Scroll the feed with the right thumb. Double-tap a post. Tap the Messenger icon in the top corner. Open a chat with Member 4. Type a reply with both thumbs. Press send. Scroll the feed again. Tap a reel and watch it. Swipe back to the chat list. Type a message to Member 1. Press send. Lower the phone onto the mattress. Roll onto the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Close the eyes. Roll onto the right side. Open the eyes. Pick up the phone again. Check the time on the lock screen. Put the phone face-down on the nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping restlessly, waking briefly several times through the night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie still with eyes closed on the bed. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Kick the blanket off the right leg. Turn onto the back. Open the eyes briefly, look at the ceiling. Turn the head toward the nightstand. Close the eyes. Turn onto the right side. Pull the pillow under the arm. Adjust the head on the pillow. Shift the legs. Open the eyes, glance at the phone screen on the nightstand. Close the eyes again. Turn onto the stomach. Turn back onto the left side. Pull the blanket up. Keep the body still until the alarm sounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking daily medication (bathroom slot used before Member 2's 07:25 shower)
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bedroom door. Open the door. Walk down the hallway to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Pick up the soap. Rub soap between the hands. Wash the face. Rinse with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the rail. Wipe the face dry. Hang the towel back. Open the mirror cabinet. Take out the medication bottle. Twist off the cap. Tip one tablet into the palm. Put the tablet on the tongue. Cup a hand under the tap. Turn on the tap. Drink the water. Turn off the tap. Twist the cap back on the bottle. Put the bottle back in the cabinet. Close the cabinet door. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out to the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating breakfast, feeding the cat, and having breakfast with Member 1 and Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Take the cat bowl from the floor. Open the cupboard below the counter. Take out the dry cat food bag. Open the bag. Pour food into the bowl. Fold the bag closed. Put the bag back. Place the bowl on the floor. Pick up the kettle. Fill it at the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the switch. Open the refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close the refrigerator. Place them on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a frying pan and a plate. Crack two eggs on the pan edge. Drop them into the pan. Turn on the induction cooker. Pick up a spatula. Turn the eggs over. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto the plate. Pick up two slices of bread. Put them in the toaster. Press the lever down. Open the kettle lid, pour hot water into a mug. Pick up a tea bag, drop it in the mug. Take the toast from the toaster. Spread butter on the toast. Carry the plate and mug to the table. Pull out a chair. Sit down. Say 'Morning' to Member 1 and Member 2 as they sit down. Pick up the fork. Eat the eggs. Pick up the mug. Drink the tea. Pick up the toast. Take bites. Talk with Member 1 about the 12:00 lunch plan. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Rinse the plate under the tap. Leave them in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing engineering lecture notes and packing study materials for campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the kitchen to Bedroom 3. Open the door. Sit down on the desk chair. Press the desk lamp switch on. Open the notebook to the last lecture page. Read the formula lines with the index finger tracing down the page. Pick up a pen. Write two lines of notes under the formula. Put the pen down. Close the notebook. Open the backpack on the bed. Put the notebook inside. Pick up the engineering textbook. Place it in the backpack. Unplug the laptop charger. Put the charger into the front pocket. Take the laptop from the desk. Slide it into the laptop sleeve. Zip the backpack. Pick up the pencil case. Drop it into the side pocket. Turn off the desk lamp. Pick up the phone from the desk. Check the time. Put the phone into the jacket pocket. Pick up the backpack. Put both straps over the shoulders.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to Monash Clayton campus for engineering classes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the front door. Pull the door closed. Walk down the front path to the street. Turn left onto the footpath. Walk past the first intersection. Adjust the backpack strap on the left shoulder. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the time. Put the phone back. Cross the road at the pedestrian lights. Press the crossing button. Wait for the green signal. Walk across. Continue along the footpath. Walk past the bus stop. Step around two pedestrians on the path. Take out earphones from the pocket. Insert them into both ears. Press play on the phone. Walk along the campus fence. Turn right at the campus gate. Walk through the gate onto the campus path. Walk past the library building. Turn toward the engineering building. Walk up the entrance steps. Push the glass door open. Walk into the lecture hall.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending engineering lectures and tutorials at Monash Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to a seat in the middle row of the lecture hall. Sit down. Take off the backpack. Place it on the floor beside the seat. Take out the notebook and pen. Open the notebook on the fold-out desk. Watch the lecturer at the front. Write the heading of the lecture. Copy the equations from the slides. Raise the hand to ask a question about the load diagram. Lower the hand. Write the answer down. Turn the page. Copy the next slide diagram. Put the pen down. Stand up at the break. Walk out to the corridor. Walk back in and sit down. Open the laptop. Type notes during the second lecture. Close the laptop at the end of the lecture. Put the notebook and pen back into the backpack. Stand up, lift the backpack onto the shoulders. Walk out of the lecture hall to the tutorial room. Sit down at a group table. Discuss the problem sheet with the group. Write the worked solution on the whiteboard with a marker. Sit back down. Submit the tutorial answer sheet to the tutor at the front desk. Stand up. Walk out of the room.

enriched_activities.activity: Having lunch on campus with Member 1 and Member 4 (aligned with Member 1's 12:00-13:00 lunch break)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk along the campus path to the food court. Spot Member 1 and Member 4 near the tables. Raise a hand to wave. Walk over to the table. Pull out a chair. Sit down. Place the backpack on the floor. Say 'Hey, how were your classes?' to Member 1. Listen to Member 1's reply. Stand up. Walk to the food counter. Pick up a tray. Choose a sandwich and a bottle of water. Carry the tray to the cashier. Take out the wallet. Hand over the card. Tap the card on the reader. Take the receipt. Carry the tray back to the table. Sit down. Unwrap the sandwich. Eat it while talking with Member 1 and Member 4. Pick up the bottle. Twist the cap off. Drink the water. Twist the cap back on. Talk with Member 4 about the lab report. Pick up the tray. Stand up. Walk to the return rack. Place the tray on the rack. Walk back to the table. Pick up the backpack. Say goodbye to Member 1 and Member 4. Walk out toward the library.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on an engineering lab report in the campus library
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the library through the entry gates. Swipe the student card on the turnstile. Walk to an empty desk near the window. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Take off the backpack. Place it on the floor. Open the backpack. Take out the laptop. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password. Open the lab report file. Scroll down to the results section. Take out the notebook. Open it to the data table. Type the measured values into the table. Switch to the graph tool. Plot the data points. Adjust the axis labels. Insert the graph into the document. Read the discussion paragraph aloud quietly. Type two more sentences. Highlight the reference lines. Open the browser. Search for a journal article. Copy the citation into the reference list. Save the file with Ctrl+S. Close the browser tab. Stretch both arms. Pick up the water bottle. Drink. Put the bottle down. Close the laptop lid. Put the laptop back into the backpack. Zip it. Stand up. Push the chair in.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the tutoring centre
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the library. Turn right onto the campus path. Walk past the bus loop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Open the map app. Check the route to the tutoring centre. Put the phone back into the pocket. Walk out of the campus gate. Turn left at the street corner. Walk along the footpath past the shops. Wait at the pedestrian crossing. Press the crossing button. Walk across when the signal turns green. Continue past the park. Take out the earphones. Insert them into both ears. Press play. Walk two more blocks. Stop in front of the tutoring centre building. Take out the earphones. Push the glass door open. Walk up the stairs to the second floor. Open the door of the tutoring room.

enriched_activities.activity: Tutoring high school students in mathematics and physics
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the tutoring room. Place the backpack on the desk. Greet the student: 'Hi, ready for today's session?' Pull out a chair. Sit down. Open the backpack. Take out the maths worksheet. Place it on the desk in front of the student. Point at question one with the pen. Explain the method step by step. Write the working on the whiteboard with a marker. Turn to the student. Ask 'Can you try the next one?' Watch the student write. Point at the sign error in the third line. Wipe the board with the eraser. Write the correction. Sit down again. Open the physics textbook. Turn to the mechanics chapter. Read the problem aloud. Draw the free-body diagram on the whiteboard. Hand the marker to the student. Ask the student to label the forces. Check the answer sheet. Tick the correct answer with a pen. Talk through the next two problems. Write the homework page number on the corner of the worksheet. Collect the worksheet. Put it in the backpack. Stand up. Say 'Great work today, see you next week.'

enriched_activities.activity: Walking home from the tutoring centre
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the tutoring centre. Turn right onto the footpath. Put the backpack straps over both shoulders. Walk past the shops. Stop at the pedestrian crossing. Press the crossing button. Walk across when the signal changes. Walk along the footpath past the park. Take the phone out of the pocket. Open the Messages app. Read a message from Member 1 about dinner. Type 'I'm cooking, be home soon'. Press send. Put the phone back. Walk past the bus stop. Continue two blocks. Cross the side street. Walk along the fence of the house row. Turn into the front path. Walk up to the front door. Take out the keys. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the door open. Step inside. Close the door behind. Slide the deadbolt across.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner from scratch ahead of the shared dinner slot
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Put the backpack on a chair. Open the refrigerator. Take out vegetables, tofu and chicken. Close the refrigerator. Place the items on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a chopping board and a knife. Place the board on the counter. Pick up the vegetables. Rinse them under the tap. Turn off the tap. Place them on the board. Cut the vegetables into pieces with the knife. Slide the pieces into a bowl. Pick up the chicken. Cut it into strips on the board. Wipe the board with a cloth. Pick up the wok. Place it on the induction cooker. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the wok. Add the chicken strips with the spatula. Stir them. Add the vegetables. Stir again. Pour in soy sauce. Add the tofu cubes. Turn the heat down. Pick up the rice cooker inner pot. Measure rice into it. Rinse the rice under the tap. Add water. Place the pot into the rice cooker. Close the lid. Press the cook button. Pick up the plates from the cupboard. Place four plates on the table. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the food into a serving dish.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the serving dish to the table. Place it in the middle. Say 'Dinner's ready' to Member 1. Pull out a chair. Sit down. Pick up the serving spoon. Spoon rice onto the plate. Pass the bowl of rice to Member 1. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the chicken and vegetables. Talk with Member 1 about the tutoring session. Pick up the glass of water. Drink. Put the glass down. Take another helping of vegetables with the spoon. Continue eating. Put the chopsticks down on the plate. Stand up. Carry the plate and glass to the sink. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place it in the drying rack. Say 'I've got the supermarket shift at 19:30' to Member 1. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and grabbing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 3. Push the door closed. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the work polo shirt and trousers. Lay them on the bed. Pull the jumper over the head. Take off the trousers. Put on the work trousers. Button the waist. Pull the work polo over the head. Tuck it into the trousers. Sit on the bed. Pick up the work shoes from beside the bed. Put on the shoes. Tie the laces. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Pick up the work bag from the chair. Open the bag. Take out the phone. Check the time. Put the phone into the trouser pocket. Pick up the name badge from the desk. Clip it to the shirt. Pick up the water bottle. Put it into the bag side pocket. Zip the bag. Hang the bag over the shoulder. Walk out of the room. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the supermarket
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the front door. Pull the door closed. Walk down the front path. Turn left onto the footpath. Adjust the bag strap on the shoulder. Walk past the first intersection. Stop at the pedestrian crossing. Press the button. Walk across on the green signal. Continue along the footpath. Walk past the pharmacy. Turn the corner onto the main street. Walk past two shops. Walk up to the supermarket entrance. Push the glass door open. Walk toward the staff room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working the evening supermarket shift, restocking shelves and serving on checkout
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the staff room. Place the bag in a locker. Close the locker. Clock in on the time terminal with the staff card. Walk out to the shop floor. Pick up a trolley of cartons from the storeroom. Push the trolley to aisle four. Stop the trolley. Pick up a carton. Open the carton with a box cutter. Take out tins. Place them on the shelf facing forward. Repeat for the next carton. Push the trolley to aisle five. Stack the bottles on the shelf. Flatten the empty cartons. Carry the cardboard to the recycling bin. Walk back to the checkout. Take the seat at the register. Greet a customer: 'Hi, how are you today?' Scan the items across the scanner. Press the subtotal key. Tell the total: 'That's $24.50.' Take the card. Tap it on the reader. Hand back the card and the receipt. Say 'Thanks, have a good night.' Serve the next three customers the same way. Press the button for a price check. Walk to aisle two with the customer. Read the shelf tag. Walk back to the register. Continue scanning for the next hour. Sweep the checkout floor with a broom. Empty the bin under the register. Return the basket stack to the entrance. Clock out on the terminal. Walk to the staff room. Open the locker. Take out the bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking home from the supermarket
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the supermarket staff door. Turn right onto the footpath. Adjust the bag strap on the shoulder. Walk past the closed shops. Stop at the pedestrian crossing. Press the button. Walk across on the green signal. Continue along the main street. Turn the corner onto the side street. Walk past the pharmacy. Walk two blocks along the footpath. Take out the phone. Check the time. Put the phone back into the pocket. Cross the small side street. Walk along the house row fence. Turn into the front path. Walk up to the front door. Take out the keys. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the door open. Step inside. Close and lock the door behind.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering after work (bathroom free after Member 2's 22:00-22:30 and Member 4's 22:30-22:50 showers)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 3. Put the work bag on the chair. Take the towel from the hook on the door. Walk to the bathroom. Push the door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Hang the towel on the rail. Pull the work polo over the head. Unbutton the trousers. Take them off. Place the clothes in the laundry basket. Step into the shower. Turn on the tap. Adjust the temperature. Stand under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub soap over the arms and body. Rinse off. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub it into the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Wrap the towel around the waist. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Hang the toothbrush back. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk to Bedroom 3.

enriched_activities.activity: Weekly Buddhist meditation practice
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 3. Push the door closed. Sit down on the cushion on the floor beside the bed. Cross the legs. Place both hands on the knees. Straighten the back. Close the eyes. Breathe in slowly through the nose. Breathe out slowly. Keep the hands still on the knees. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn the head slightly toward the small Buddha statue on the shelf. Place both palms together in front of the chest. Bow the head forward. Lower the hands back onto the knees. Open the eyes. Stand up from the cushion. Pick up the cushion. Place it beside the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Organizing the household chore roster and rent split on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Press the desk lamp switch on. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password. Open the spreadsheet file. Click the chore roster sheet tab. Type 'Member 1 - Kitchen' in the Monday row. Type 'Member 2 - Bathroom' in the Tuesday row. Type 'Member 4 - Living Room' in the Wednesday row. Type 'Member 5 - Kitchen' in the Thursday row. Type 'Member 3 - Bathroom' in the Friday row. Scroll down the sheet. Click the rent split tab. Type the four amounts into the payment column. Check the total with the calculator on the phone. Type the final figure in the total cell. Save the file with Ctrl+S. Close the spreadsheet. Shut down the laptop. Close the lid. Turn off the desk lamp. Push the chair in.

enriched_activities.activity: Settling into bed and turning off the light
enriched_activities.desc: Pull back the blanket. Sit on the edge of the bed. Take off the slippers. Place them beside the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Turn onto the right side. Reach out to the nightstand. Pick up the phone. Press the power button. Place the phone face-down on the nightstand. Reach to the bedside lamp. Press the switch off. Pull the pillow under the head. Close the eyes.
